end.summary:
Practised identifying top, front and side views of cubes, cylinders and cones.
Matched 2 of 4 views without help.
Reyansh identified a cube’s square faces and a cone’s triangular side view.
They mixed up top and side views, especially for circular solids; this was corrected for the cylinder and cone during the lesson.
The idea that objects look the same from every side was still seen at the end.
end.parentNote: Reyansh practised describing and matching solid shapes from the top, front and side using cubes, cylinders and cones. They used each solid’s face shape to explain answers, and corrected the cylinder and cone view mix-up later in the lesson. At home, show one object at a time and ask, “What would it look like from above, in front, and from the side?”
